items.title: Add a digest-bound playbook_candidate_ingest command
items.context: Wrap playbook_seed_observe -> playbook_seed_propose_batch --apply -> playbook_candidate_batch_approve --apply with observeDigest and manifestDigest checks, source/story filters, limits, shared learning-store locking, and idempotent no-duplicate behavior.
items.userSees: A single command can convert eligible DONE/story seeds into candidate playbooks and report created/skipped/blocked counts.

happy.desc: Given DONE experience seeds and no existing playbooks, playbook_candidate_ingest --apply creates candidate playbooks and reports candidatePlaybooks > 0 without activating them.

edge.desc: Re-running the command with the same source/story is idempotent and does not duplicate proposals or candidates.

adversarial.desc: Digest drift, duplicate canonical source, non_promotable source, or invalid source filter fails closed without creating active playbooks.

verificationEvidence.note: Dist CLI parses playbook_candidate_ingest and dry-run reports sourceFilter=done-experience, proposedCount=5, candidateCreatedCount=0, observe/proposal/manifest digests, authority=non_authoritative, gateEvidence=false without mutating stores.
B-a4f7 smoke proves apply creates one candidate from a DONE seed and a repeated same-story ingest creates zero new candidates while preserving unrelated staged proposals.
Smoke covers scoped approval, already represented sources, duplicate canonicalSourceKey rejection, and no active playbooks/outcomes/auto-activation rows from candidate ingest.

items.title: Wire post-DONE settlement to non-blocking candidate ingestion
items.context: After story_advance DONE records learning settlement, optionally run candidate ingestion for that DONE story with a small per-story limit. The hook must be default-on unless explicitly disabled, non-blocking for DONE, and must write health diagnostics on success or failure.
items.userSees: A new DONE story can automatically leave behind candidate playbook material instead of only settlement health rows.
excludes: blocking DONE on learning ingestion failure

happy.desc: A simulated post-DONE settlement runs candidate ingestion and produces at least one inert candidate for the completed story.

edge.desc: If no eligible DONE seed exists, DONE still succeeds and records a clear zero-created health diagnostic.

adversarial.desc: Ingestion errors are captured as non-authoritative health rows and never mark a candidate helped or active.

verificationEvidence.note: B-a4f7 post-DONE settlement hook smoke proves default-on PLAYBOOK_DONE_CANDIDATE_INGEST_ENABLED creates one inert candidate for the completed DONE story.
Repeated post-DONE settlement returns candidateIngestStatus=no_candidates and keeps DONE settlement recorded without duplicating candidates.
DONE hook smoke verifies candidate opt-out prevents candidate creation and the hook writes no helped outcome or auto-activation rows; failures are represented as non-authoritative health diagnostics.

items.title: Prove candidate consumption boundary remains safe
items.context: Candidates produced by automatic ingestion must remain separate from active runtime guidance until explicit exposure/outcome evidence satisfies playbook_auto_promotion_apply. Story completion itself remains source material rather than outcome proof.
items.userSees: playbook_runtime_consumption_verify shows candidates are inert and active playbooks only appear after evidence activation.
excludes: candidate guidance mixed into active runtime pack

happy.desc: After ingestion, runtime verification reports candidate inertness and no active playbook unless evidence activation is separately applied.

edge.desc: A candidate with only DONE-settlement rows cannot be activated.

adversarial.desc: Candidate ingestion never writes playbook outcome helped rows and never writes auto-activation audit rows.

verificationEvidence.note: Runtime verification smoke proves active playbooks surface while candidate playbooks remain inert pending learning, including automatically ingested candidates.

Smoke proves DONE-settlement-only / no-real-outcome candidates cannot drive evidence activation; playbook_auto_promotion_apply fails closed until explicit exposure/outcome and recommendation evidence exist.
Candidate ingest and DONE hook smoke assert zero playbook outcome rows and zero auto-activation rows; candidate status remains candidate, never active.

items.title: Update execution docs and status surfaces
items.context: Document the new automatic ingestion layer, config/flag boundary, command sequence, health output, and distinction between candidate ingestion and evidence activation.
items.userSees: Status commands make it obvious whether story data is only settled, converted to candidate, or activated.

happy.desc: Docs and status output mention playbook_candidate_ingest and DONE candidate ingestion.

edge.desc: Docs clearly state history backfill is separate and candidate ingestion does not auto-activate.

adversarial.desc: Docs preserve gateEvidence=false authority boundary for candidate ingestion.
